s2.ptxt: Operate the A/C under the following conditions.

atten3.ptxt: If the A/C cannot be operated due to compressor lock etc., operation is not necessary.

s2.ptxt: Stop the engine.
Connect a refrigerant recovery/recycling machine and recover the refrigerant gas.

atten3.ptxt: When using a refrigerant recovery/recycling machine, use it correctly according to its instruction manual.

s2.ptxt: Place both hands on the front of the cover and lift it upward to disengage the 2 front clips, then continue lifting upward to disengage the 1 rear clips, and remove the V-bank cover.

atten3.ptxt: Pulling up the front and rear at the same time may cause damage.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 9 clips and the radiator upper air deflector.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Under Cover Rear RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 clips and the engine under cover rear RH.
Put a tool on the pulley set bolt of the tensioner, and turn the tensioner counterclockwise to loosen the tension.

item.ptxt: Performing this from under the vehicle may damage the tensioner.
The pulley set bolt has a left-hand thread, so turning it clockwise loosens the pulley set bolt.

s2.ptxt: Using a 5mm hexagon wrench, fix the tensioner as shown in the illustration and remove the belt.
Loosen the nut and disconnect the battery positive terminal. (*1)
Remove the bolt and nut, and remove the battery clamp.
Remove the insulator.
Remove the battery.
Remove the 2 radiator grille protectors.
Disengage the 2 clips and remove the radiator side cover RH.
Remove the 6 bolts and 7 clips, and remove the engine under cover No.1.
Using a flat-tip screwdriver, turn the pin hold clip 90° and remove the pin hold clip.

atten4.ptxt: Perform the same procedure on the RH side.

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape around the front bumper assembly.
Using a clip remover, remove the 3 upper clips.
Remove the 6 screws, 2 clips and 2 bolts.
Pull the front bumper assembly outward from the vehicle to disengage the 8 claws (4 each on LH/RH).
Disconnect the connectors.
Pull the front bumper assembly toward the front of the vehicle and remove the front bumper assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Millimeter Wave Radar Sensor Assembly (w/ Cruise Control (w/ Radar Cruise))

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Remove the 3 bolts and the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Millimeter Wave Radar Sensor Bracket NO.1 (w/ Cruise Control (w/ Radar Cruise))

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and millimeter wave radar sensor bracket NO.1.
Disengage the 3 clips and guide, and remove the radiator side cover LH.
Disengage the 2 clips and remove the radiator side cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Drain Coolant (Toyota Genuine Super Long Life Coolant)

atten2.ptxt: To avoid the danger of being burned, do not remove the reservoir tank cap while the engine and radiator are still hot. Liquid and steam will spray out under pressure.

s2.ptxt: Loosen the radiator drain cock plug.
Remove the reserve tank cap and drain the coolant.
Loosen the cylinder block drain cock plug and drain the coolant from the engine.
Slide the 2 clamps and disconnect water bypass hose No.1 and water bypass hose No.3.
Detach the hood lock control assembly from the 2 clamps.
Remove the 3 bolts and disconnect the hood lock assembly.
Disconnect the 2 horn assembly connectors.
Remove the 4 bolts and radiator support assembly.
Detach the 2 clamps and disconnect the 2 horn assembly connectors from fan shroud No.2.
Remove the 2 bolts and separate fan shroud No.2 from the radiator assembly.
Slide the 2 clamps and disconnect water bypass hose No.1 and water bypass hose No.3.
Slide the clamp and disconnect radiator hose NO.2.
Remove the clamp and disconnect the radiator hose NO.1.

atten4.ptxt: Pinch the claws at the clamp joint to remove it.

s2.ptxt: Slide the clamp and disconnect radiator hose NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Oil Cooler Inlet Hose NO.1

s2.ptxt: Slide the clamp and disconnect the oil cooler inlet hose NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Oil Cooler Outlet Hose NO.1

s2.ptxt: Slide the clamp and disconnect the oil cooler outlet hose NO.1.
Disconnect the cooling fan motor connector and 2 wire harness clamps.
Detach the clip and disconnect the thermistor assembly.
Separate the cooler condenser assembly from the fan shroud.
Remove the radiator assembly together with the fan shroud from the vehicle.

atten3.ptxt: When removing the radiator assembly, do not apply excessive force to the cooler condenser assembly and pipes.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 radiator supports lower.
Slide the 2 clamps and disconnect the oil cooler hoses from the radiator assembly.
Remove the 2 bolts and remove the fan shroud from the radiator assembly.
Disengage the clamp.
Disconnect the connectors.
Remove the bolt and disconnect the suction hose.
Remove the O-ring from the suction hose.

atten3.ptxt: Seal the openings of the disconnected suction hose and cooler compressor w/ magnet clutch assembly with vinyl tape to prevent dirt, moisture, etc. from entering.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and disconnect the discharge hose.
Remove the O-ring from the discharge hose.

atten3.ptxt: Seal the openings of the disconnected discharge hose and cooler compressor w/ magnet clutch assembly with vinyl tape to prevent dirt, moisture, etc. from entering

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cooler Compressor w/ Magnetic Clutch Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and the cooler compressor w/ magnetic clutch assembly.
Disconnect the connector from the crank position sensor.
Remove the bolt and remove the crank position sensor.
